title: MOCHA: A Dataset for Training and Evaluating Generative Reading Comprehension Metrics
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset and metrics for evaluating the correctness of answers in generative reading comprehension. The examples and datasets used (e.g., NarrativeQA, MCScript, CosmosQA) are based on general knowledge, stories, and commonsense reasoning, with no component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
